additional_info.subject: ID0383766-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P7 170000785] Display black CRM:00642001619
additional_info.body:
Hello Team
,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
BayWA r.e. Operation Service GmbH
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P7 170000785
Charger ID/Serial No.:
evBHNP
Problem Description:
Display black
FYI-
Regarding the reported issue and pictures of a black terminal screen, please take the following action on your end, as it will assist in resolving the problem.
1.
Please reboot the charger.
1. The DP cable needs to be replaced. Use a new 1.5m cable (Official Siemens spare part only, no other brands), and ensure it is routed as far away from routers as possible to avoid EMC performance issues, as identified by R&D.
2. Verify the 24VDC power supply is set to 25VDC.
3. Additionally, check whether the LED strips are faulty.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0374481
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
Please refer to the attached knowledge article link for more information.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_HMI_Black_Screen/Scrambled_Screen - Dynamics 365
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 7/1/2024, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Mohini Patil
